### Batch: 20200528

## Use Astir for automated cell type assignment

see [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471221003355?via%3Dihub) for full publication (Geuenich et al.,2021, Cell Systems).

Here, I will test astir-based cell type assignments RCC IMMUcan batches (Run-each batch.) 
"Ground truth"=manually labelled cell types by IMMUCAN

```{r load-data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(scater)
library(uwot)
library(tidyverse)
library(Rphenograph)

sce <- readRDS("~/switchdrive/RCC_project/data/rcc_sce_Batch20200528.rds")
```

```{r astir-expo,fig.width=15,fig.height=10}
#Export arsinh normalized expression matrix as csv
#Add sampleID as covariate in design matrix

expr_astir <- assay(sce,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(sample = sce$SampleId)

write.csv(expr_astir, file = "~/Desktop/Astir/expr_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

`Next: Run Astir via conda-environment.`

```{r astir-ana,fig.width=15,fig.height=10, message = FALSE}
library(caret)
library(foreach)

#Import Astir cell type assignments
astir_type <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Astir/cell_types.csv",col_names = c("ID","cell_type"),skip = 1)

sce$astir_type <- astir_type$cell_type

T_cell = c("cytolytic_CD8","CD8_other","cytolytic_exhausted_CD8","Treg","exhausted_CD8","CD4_other",           "cytolytic_CD4","PD1_CD4","cytolytic_PD1_CD4") 
B_cell = c("B_cell")
tumor = c("Tumor","Tumor_Ki67")
neutrophil = c("Neutrophil")
macrophage = c("Macrophage")
plasma = c("CD38")
stroma = c("Stroma")

astir_test <- colData(sce) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(cell_labels,astir_type) %>% 
  filter(cell_labels != "unlabelled") %>% 
  mutate(cell_label_simple = ifelse(cell_labels %in% T_cell,"T_cells", 
                                    ifelse(cell_labels %in% B_cell,"B_cells",
                                           ifelse(cell_labels %in% tumor,"Tumor",
                                                  ifelse(cell_labels %in% plasma, "Plasma_cells",
                                                         ifelse(cell_labels %in% macrophage, "Macrophages",
                                                                ifelse(cell_labels %in% stroma,"Stroma",
                                                                       ifelse(cell_labels %in% neutrophil,"Neutrophils", "Unknown/Other")
                                                                              ))))))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(astir_type = ifelse(astir_type %in% c("Unknown","Other","Epithelial"),"Unknown/Other",astir_type))
                                                                                    

#Test specificity and sensitivity in current batch
run<-unique(astir_test$cell_label_simple)
astir_senspe <- foreach(i = seq_along(run),.combine = rbind,.errorhandling = "remove") %do% {
sen <- sensitivity(table(astir_test$astir_type == run[i],astir_test$cell_label_simple == run[i]))
spe <- specificity(table(astir_test$astir_type == run[i],astir_test$cell_label_simple == run[i]))
data.frame(sen = sen, spe = spe, row.names = run[i])  
}



write.csv(astir_senspe, file = paste0("~/Desktop/Astir/",unique(sce$BatchId),"_astir_senspe.csv"))
```

# Combine astir testing results and visualize

```{r astir viz-1, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggpubr)

astir_1 <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Astir/Batch20200528_astir_senspe.csv")
astir_2 <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Astir/Batch20201113_astir_senspe.csv")

astir_comb <- rbind(astir_1,astir_2)

sen <- ggplot(astir_comb, aes(X, sen)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar', width = 0.2)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = X), size = 5)+
  ylab("Sensitivity")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_line_size = 0.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),axis.title.x.bottom = element_blank())+
  guides(color=FALSE)

spe <- ggplot(astir_comb, aes(X, spe)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar', width = 0.2)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = X), size = 5)+
  ylab("Specificity")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_line_size = 0.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),axis.title.x.bottom = element_blank())+
  guides(color=FALSE)

ggarrange(sen,spe, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, align = "h")

```
